title: PE Factory Repair: pipeline friction fixes + bounded-autonomy defaults
objective: Repair the Cursor-Governance program-execution factory using evidence collected while driving campaign website-bot-five-push-v1: remove mechanical friction that stops or slows agent campaigns (workspace-resolution gaps, auth channels unreachable in-session, secrets path-guards, npm registry auth, unverified dependency publishes, stale Graphiti conflict edges) and encode the operator's new operating defaults — default authorization = open PR, remediate until green and mergeable, then HALT before merge; stacked PRs merged bottom-up with no rebase; all work on a single feature branch off main; authorization YAMLs updated so approval requirements are unblocked before PRs open. Non-negotiable preserved contracts: merge stays human-only; gates stay fail-closed; scanners are never weakened; protected PE core templates and the concurrent pe/pipeline-fixes workstream files are not touched by this program. Success properties SP-01..SP-09 carry the evidence-typed acceptance criteria.

disconfirming_questions: What if remediation cycles exceed max_cycles before green? -> terminal halt + FAIL evidence, no merge, human decides (policy must say so).
What if a merge-authorization file is forged, stale, or for a different PR/SHA? -> denied; unit-tested both directions.
What if the open PR head that a stacked PR bases on gets force-changed or closed? -> stacked PR stays on recorded base SHA; fallback documented; no rebase.
What if the in-flight pe/pipeline-fixes agent later modifies one of my scoped files? -> CP1/CP4 re-diff; stop_and_replan.
What if merge_gate regression denies ALL merges machine-wide? -> fail-closed direction is annoying but safe; tests must also prove allow-path works to avoid lockout.
What if Graphiti VPS is unreachable during conflicts filtering? -> unit tests mocked; live path degrades to unfiltered with warning, gate unchanged.
assumed_false_ifs: Hook invocation contract (stdin JSON event) unchanged.
Governance venv python and validators present at execution.
pe/pipeline-fixes workstream files remain as inventoried today.
stress_test.blast_radius: merge_gate + surface_profile govern every agent session on this machine — a regression either locks out all merges (fail-closed, recoverable) or widens autonomy (dangerous). Both directions unit-tested; default deny preserved.
stress_test.rollback: git_restore_scoped_paths per changed file from baseline SHA; receipts recorded; no force-push/hard-reset; policy YAML rollback = restore previous file versions.

shared_causes: Workspace/session-resolution divergence across gates (L4 gate vs lock tool vs memory gate) — one root-cause family; each fix removes a stop.
Auth channels reachable only by humans or only by session env — agents burn cycles on mechanical workarounds.
Dependency publish state never verified at author time — defects surface only at CI/merge time.
deletions_or_consolidations: Follow-on (separate plan, after in-flight workstream lands): consolidate workspace resolution into one shared helper used by local_execution_gate, merge_gate, memory_lock — deletes duplicated per-gate resolution logic.
remediation_after_pr + l9_pr_remediation_spawn forbid entries replaced by one bounded remediation policy (surface_profile) — consolidation of scattered remediation rules.
